visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black t-shirt and a woman in a blue dress stand in a brightly lit studio. A music stand is in front of them, and a laptop sits on a small table to the side. The man points towards his throat while looking at the woman. (2) The man begins to gesticulate more expressively with his hands, moving them near his chest and neck as if demonstrating a physical technique. The woman stands beside him, observing his movements with a focused expression. (3) The man continues his expressive physical demonstrations, occasionally glancing at the laptop screen. He uses wide arm movements and hand gestures to emphasize certain points. (4) Multiple sets of hands enter the frame from both sides, clapping enthusiastically. The man and woman smile broadly and high-five each other in a celebratory manner.
